changes: New: CODEC ECHO, an echo on the tempo (1/32 to 1/2) whose repeats pass through a lossy codec, on FX2.
LOSS darkens and coarsens every repeat; DROP and PKT lose packets, concealed by silence or a repeat (PLC).
A 1.44 s line at half the rate in 12 bits; MIX 0 is the dry, untouched.
Needs the Modwerk base loaded over USB (beta). Not yet tested on a unit or in the emulator.
